meaning_en: a formal decision or arrangement
example_en: They reached an agreement after long talks.
examples_extra: The two companies signed an agreement yesterday.
We finally reached an agreement after long talks.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: reach/sign an agreement؛ in agreement with.

meaning_en: To give something for a specific purpose.
example_en: We need to allocate funds for the new project.
examples_extra: The school allocated funds for new computers.
Each group was allocated a different task.
note_fa: یعنی تخصیص دادن برای هدف مشخص.

meaning_en: Money given regularly, often to children.
example_en: My parents give me a weekly allowance for chores.
examples_extra: She gets a weekly allowance from her parents.
His monthly allowance covers food and transport.
note_fa: پول توجیبی منظم، معمولاً برای بچه‌ها.

meaning_en: A plan or agreement made for something.
example_en: We made an arrangement to meet on Friday.
examples_extra: We made an arrangement to share the driving on the trip.
The flower arrangement on the table looked lovely.
note_fa: اسمِ arrange؛ در جدول verb/noun کتاب.

meaning_en: To try to do something, often difficult.
example_en: He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
examples_extra: His first attempt at skiing ended in a funny fall.
She attempted to climb the mountain alone last year.
note_fa: attempt to do یعنی «تلاش برای انجام».

meaning_en: Having little or no hair on the head.
example_en: My uncle started to go bald in his thirties.
examples_extra: My uncle started going bald when he was only thirty years old.
The old man was completely bald and wore a warm hat.
note_fa: go bald یعنی «کچل شدن» — درباره موی سر.

meaning_en: Washing your body in a tub of water.
example_en: I like to take a warm bath at night.
examples_extra: She had a long hot bath after the tiring journey.
The children take a bath every evening before bed.
note_fa: have a bath — حمام کردن در وان.

meaning_en: The things you own.
example_en: Please take all your belongings with you.
examples_extra: She packed all her belongings into one small bag.
Please do not leave your belongings on the bus.
note_fa: همیشه جمع است: belongings (نه a belonging).

meaning_en: Unable to see.
example_en: The old man is blind.
examples_extra: She helps blind children learn to read and write.
He was blind in one eye after the accident.
note_fa: go blind یعنی «کم‌کم کور شدن».

meaning_en: To tell someone bad or important news gently.
example_en: It was hard to break the news of her father's death.
examples_extra: The doctor broke the news to the family gently.
How will you break the news to your parents?
note_fa: یعنی خبر (بد) را رساندن.

meaning_en: To separate from something larger.
example_en: A small piece of the rock broke off.
examples_extra: A small piece of rock will break off and fall.
He will break off a bit of chocolate for me.
note_fa: جدا شدن بخشی از چیزی.

meaning_en: The first meal of the day.
example_en: I eat toast for breakfast.
examples_extra: We had a big breakfast at seven this morning.
She never eats breakfast before going to school.
note_fa: have breakfast یعنی صبحانه خوردن.

meaning_en: To take something or someone to a place.
example_en: Please bring your book tomorrow.
examples_extra: Please bring your book to class tomorrow morning.
Can you bring me a glass of water, please?
note_fa: فرق با take: bring یعنی به سمتِ گوینده آوردن.

meaning_en: To cause something to happen.
example_en: The new law brought about many changes.
examples_extra: The new law brought about major changes in the tax system.
Her powerful speech brought about a wave of protests across the country.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از cause؛ معمولاً برای تغییراتِ بزرگ.

meaning_en: To return something or someone.
example_en: Don't forget to bring back the keys.
examples_extra: The shop brought back the old design because customers loved it.
This song brings back so many happy memories for me.
note_fa: دو معنی: برگرداندن و دوباره معرفی کردن.

meaning_en: To cause a government or leader to fall.
example_en: The scandal could bring down the government.
examples_extra: The corruption scandal brought down the government last spring.
Cheaper imports brought down prices in the local market.
note_fa: هم برای دولت (سرنگون کردن) هم قیمت‌ها (پایین آوردن).

meaning_en: To make a law or rule start to be used.
example_en: The new regulations will be brought into force next month.
examples_extra: Parliament brought the new law into force in January.
The safety rule was brought into force after months of debate.
note_fa: برای قانون؛ معمولاً به صورتِ مجهول به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: To make something secret known publicly.
example_en: The report brought the corruption into the open.
examples_extra: The report brought the financial scandal into the open at last.
She decided to bring her concerns into the open at the meeting.
note_fa: یعنی آشکار کردنِ موضوعی پنهان.

meaning_en: To cause something, often unpleasant, to happen.
example_en: Stress can bring on a headache.
examples_extra: The cold weather brought on his asthma attack last night.
Too much stress can bring on serious headaches.
note_fa: اغلب برای شروعِ چیزهای ناخوشایند (سرفه، درد).

meaning_en: To produce and start to sell a new product.
example_en: The company will bring out a new phone soon.
examples_extra: The company will bring out a new phone next month.
She brought out her first novel in 2020.
note_fa: برای معرفیِ محصولِ جدید یا چاپِ کتاب.

meaning_en: To make someone show their best qualities.
example_en: Challenges often bring out the best in people.
examples_extra: Good teachers know how to bring out the best in their students.
The tough competition brought out the best in both teams.
note_fa: یعنی باعث شدن که بهترینِ کسی دیده شود.

meaning_en: To succeed in doing something difficult.
example_en: It was a tough task, but he brought it off.
examples_extra: It was very risky, but she brought it off in the end.
He brought off the difficult deal despite all the problems.
note_fa: غیررسمی؛ یعنی موفق شدن در کاری دشوار.

meaning_en: To make someone conscious again.
example_en: We tried to bring her round after she fainted.
examples_extra: The doctor soon brought her round with cold water.
He fainted, but the nurse brought him round quickly.
note_fa: یعنی به هوش آوردن؛ در بریتانیا «قانع کردن» هم معنی می‌دهد.

meaning_en: To make a situation reach a crisis point.
meaning_fa: به اوج رساندن، به نقطه بحرانی رساندن
example_en: The argument was brought to a head yesterday.
examples_extra: The pay dispute was finally brought to a head by the strike.
Her sudden resignation brought matters to a head in the office.
note_fa: یعنی رساندنِ موضوع به نقطهٔ بحران.

meaning_en: To reveal something previously unknown.
example_en: New evidence brought the truth to light.
examples_extra: The long inquiry brought several new facts to light.
Her old diary brought the truth to light many years later.
note_fa: یعنی آشکار کردنِ حقیقتی پنهان.

meaning_en: To mention a subject or topic.
example_en: Don't bring up that topic again.
examples_extra: She brought up an interesting point during the meeting.
Please do not bring up politics at dinner tonight.
note_fa: یعنی مطرح کردنِ موضوع (با bring sb up فرق دارد).

meaning_en: To provide food and drink for an event.
example_en: They will cater the wedding reception.
examples_extra: The company catered the wedding for two hundred guests.
Who is catering the party on Saturday?
note_fa: معمولاً: cater for somebody.

meaning_en: A food made from milk, often yellow or white.
example_en: I like cheese on my sandwich.
examples_extra: She put some cheese on the pizza.
This cheese smells strong but tastes delicious.
note_fa: پنیر.

meaning_en: A dark brown drink made from roasted beans.
example_en: I drink coffee every morning.
examples_extra: Would you like a hot cup of coffee?
I usually drink two strong coffees every morning.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش؛ a coffee یعنی یک فنجان قهوه.

meaning_en: A common illness that makes you sneeze and cough.
example_en: I have a cold and feel tired.
examples_extra: I caught a really nasty cold last week.
She has a bad cold and a cough.
note_fa: به‌معنای اسم یعنی سرماخوردگی؛ catch a cold.

meaning_en: To move towards the speaker or a place.
example_en: Can you come to my party?
examples_extra: Please come here at five o'clock.
They come to our house for dinner every Friday.
note_fa: come = به سمت گوینده آمدن؛ go = دور شدن.

meaning_en: To find something or someone by chance.
example_en: I came across an old photo album today.
examples_extra: You never know what you will come across in an old shop.
Did you come across my keys anywhere?
note_fa: اتفاقی و ناگهانی پیدا کردن، نه با جستجو.

meaning_en: To go with someone to a place.
example_en: Do you want to come along with us?
examples_extra: We are going to the park; do you want to come along?
She comes along with us to the museum every month.
note_fa: همراه کسی جایی رفتن؛ با with رایج است.

meaning_en: To visit me.
example_en: Please come and see me soon.
examples_extra: Come and see me after school tomorrow.
She said, 'Come and see me when you are in town.'
note_fa: صمیمانه یعنی «به دیدنم بیا».

meaning_en: To return to a place.
example_en: He will come back home later.
examples_extra: She went away for a week but has come back now.
I will come back to help you after lunch.
note_fa: come back + from: بازگشت «از» جایی.

meaning_en: To return from a place.
example_en: When did you come back from your trip?
examples_extra: They have just come back from Italy.
When did you come back from your holiday?
note_fa: همیشه اسم مکان بعدش می‌آید: from Italy.

meaning_en: To cause a disagreement between people.
example_en: Don't let small issues come between friends.
examples_extra: Do not let money come between you and your friends.
Do not let small arguments come between you and your brother.
note_fa: «جدایی انداختن میان دو نفر».

meaning_en: To visit someone for a short time.
example_en: Can you come by my office later?
examples_extra: Come by my office tomorrow morning.
She will come by to see the new baby tomorrow.
note_fa: «سر زدن» کوتاه و غیررسمی.

meaning_en: To move from a higher to a lower place.
example_en: The rain started to come down heavily.
examples_extra: The children come down the stairs for breakfast.
He comes down from the ladder very carefully.
note_fa: معنای رایج دیگر: کم شدن قیمت یا دما.

meaning_en: To originate or be born in a place.
example_en: I come from a small town.
examples_extra: She comes from a small village in Spain.
Where do you come from originally?
note_fa: برای ملیت: I come from (نه I'm coming from).

meaning_en: To return to your house.
example_en: What time do you come home?
examples_extra: What time will you come home tonight?
He comes home very late after parties.
note_fa: home بعدش to نمی‌گیرد: come home.

meaning_en: To enter a place.
example_en: Please come in, it's cold outside.
examples_extra: Come in and sit down, please.
Please knock and then come into the room.
note_fa: وقتی کسی در می‌زند: Come in! یعنی «بیا تو».

meaning_en: To enter a place or situation.
example_en: The car came into the garage.
examples_extra: She comes into the classroom quietly every morning.
Please come into the room and sit down.
note_fa: مثل come in ولی همیشه با مفعول مکانی.

meaning_en: To leave a place or appear.
example_en: The cat came out from under the bed.
examples_extra: The children come out of school at three.
Please come out of the water now.
note_fa: متضاد come in؛ با of: come out of مدرسه.

meaning_en: To leave a place or situation.
example_en: She came out of the meeting looking happy.
examples_extra: She comes out of the building with a smile every day.
They will come out of the cinema at midnight.
note_fa: مثل come out ولی همیشه با مفعول مکانی.

meaning_en: To become separated from something.
example_en: The button came off my shirt.
examples_extra: One of the buttons has come off my coat.
The paint started to come off the old door.
note_fa: مثلاً دکمه از لباس «کنده شدن».

meaning_en: To regain consciousness after fainting.
example_en: She fainted but soon came round.
examples_extra: He fainted but he will soon come round.
The nurse waited until the patient had come round.
note_fa: «به هوش آمدن»؛ با come round [visit] فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To reach a total amount.
example_en: The bill came to fifty dollars.
examples_extra: The bill comes to twenty pounds.
All the costs will come to more than we expected.
note_fa: برای جمع شدن مبلغ: The bill came to £20.

meaning_en: To move upwards or appear.
example_en: A new problem came up today.
examples_extra: Important questions often come up in our meetings.
New words often come up in our English class.
note_fa: «پیش آمدن/مطرح شدن»؛ come up with = پیشنهاد دادن.

meaning_en: The end of something; a final decision.
example_en: In conclusion, we need more time.
examples_extra: In conclusion, I would like to thank everyone.
We finally reached a conclusion after hours of discussion.
note_fa: in conclusion = در پایان (شروع نتیجه‌گیری).

meaning_en: To give something, especially money or help.
example_en: Everyone contributed to the team's success.
examples_extra: Everyone contributed money to buy her a present.
She contributes articles to the school magazine.
note_fa: «مشارکت کردن»؛ با to: contribute to cancer research.

meaning_en: Something you like or are good at.
example_en: Reading is my cup of tea.
examples_extra: Classical music is not really my cup of tea.
Hiking in the rain is just not her cup of tea.
note_fa: یعنی باب میل بودن؛ معمولاً با not می‌آید.

meaning_en: Unable to hear, either completely or partly.
example_en: My grandfather is a little deaf.
examples_extra: She has been deaf since birth.
He is going deaf and needs a hearing aid.
note_fa: ناشنوا؛ go deaf یعنی ناشنوا شدن.

meaning_en: A choice you make after thinking.
example_en: Making a big decision can be hard.
examples_extra: Making a final decision took the whole afternoon.
It was a difficult decision, but the right one.
note_fa: با make/take می‌آید: make a decision، نه do a decision.

meaning_en: To perform an action or activity.
example_en: What do you do on weekends?
examples_extra: What are you doing this weekend? Let's meet up.
She does her homework every evening after dinner.
note_fa: فعل کمکی هم هست؛ do homework نه make homework.

meaning_en: To study a series of lessons.
example_en: I want to do a photography course.
examples_extra: She is doing a course in photography this term.
He will do a cooking course next summer.
note_fa: دوره گذراندن؛ take a course هم رایج است.

meaning_en: To buy and sell goods or services.
meaning_fa: تجارت کردن، کسب و کار کردن
example_en: Our company does business internationally.
examples_extra: Our company does business with many countries in Asia.
It is easy to do business online these days.
note_fa: تجارت کردن؛ do business with یعنی «معامله با».

meaning_en: To buy or sell things with a company.
example_en: We do business with many local suppliers.
examples_extra: We do business with a large company in Japan.
He has done business with them for ten years.
note_fa: با شرکت‌ها معامله کردن؛ with اجباری است.

meaning_en: To do physical activity to stay healthy.
example_en: I try to do exercise every morning.
examples_extra: Doctors say we should do exercise every day.
She does exercise at the gym three times a week.
note_fa: ورزش کردن؛ take exercise هم در بریتانیایی رایج است.

meaning_en: To complete school assignments at home.
example_en: My children do their homework after school.
examples_extra: The children do their homework before watching TV.
She forgot to do her homework last night.
note_fa: do homework درست است؛ make homework غلط است.

meaning_en: To clean and tidy your home.
example_en: I help my mother do housework on Saturdays.
examples_extra: He helps his mother do the housework at weekends.
They do the housework together on Saturdays.
note_fa: کارهای خانه؛ do the housework با the.

meaning_en: To perform physical activities for health.
example_en: Let's do some exercises before we start work.
examples_extra: I do some exercise every morning before work.
Doing some exercise each day keeps you healthy and strong.
note_fa: do با ورزش‌ها می‌آید نه make: do yoga درست، make yoga غلط.

meaning_en: To perform an action or no action.
example_en: We must do something about this problem.
examples_extra: If you do nothing all day, you will feel bored.
When you do something kind, people remember it.
note_fa: nothing همیشه مفرد است: nothing was wrong؛ was نه were.

meaning_en: To work in the garden.
example_en: My grandmother loves to do the gardening.
examples_extra: I do the gardening with my father on weekends.
They are doing the gardening while the weather is nice.
note_fa: با do می‌آید نه make: do the gardening درست است.

meaning_en: To clean and tidy your home.
example_en: We take turns doing the housework.
examples_extra: We do the housework together every Friday evening.
Doing the housework is easier with some music on.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش است: much housework درست، many houseworks غلط.

meaning_en: To wash clothes.
example_en: I need to do the washing today; the basket is full.
examples_extra: I do the washing while my husband cooks dinner.
Doing the washing by hand takes too long.
note_fa: یعنی شستن لباس؛ do the washing-up یعنی شستن ظرف‌ها.

meaning_en: To wash the dishes after a meal.
example_en: Can you help me do the washing-up?
examples_extra: Who will do the washing-up after dinner tonight?
I do not mind doing the washing-up at all.
note_fa: یعنی شستن ظرف‌ها؛ در آمریکا می‌گویند do the dishes.

meaning_en: To manage without something you usually have.
example_en: We can do without a car for a week.
examples_extra: I cannot do without my morning coffee.
We had to do without heating for two days.
note_fa: یعنی بدون چیزی سر کردن؛ بعدش اسم می‌آید: do without sugar.

meaning_en: Do you enjoy something?
example_en: Do you like listening to music?
examples_extra: Do you like spicy food?
Do you like living in a big city?
note_fa: بعد از like هم فعل ingدار می‌آید هم مصدر با to.

meaning_en: To try as hard as you can.
example_en: Just do your best in the exam.
examples_extra: Just do your best and do not worry about the result.
The team is doing its best to win the match.
note_fa: یعنی تمام تلاشت را بکن.

meaning_en: To style your hair or apply cosmetics.
example_en: She takes ages to do her hair.
examples_extra: It takes her an hour to do her hair and make-up.
I never do my make-up before going to the gym.
note_fa: do one's hair یعنی موها را آراستن؛ do make-up یعنی آرایش کردن.

meaning_en: To give money or goods to help people.
example_en: Many people donate blood to save lives.
examples_extra: Many people donate money to help the victims.
She donates blood twice a year.
note_fa: با to یا for می‌آید: donate to charity.

meaning_en: A liquid you can swallow. To swallow liquid.
example_en: I need a cold drink.
examples_extra: Would you like a hot drink?
He does not drink coffee after six.
note_fa: هم اسم (نوشیدنی) است هم فعل (نوشیدن)؛ have a drink رایج است.

meaning_en: The final part of something.
example_en: We live at the end of the street.
examples_extra: We stayed until the end of the film.
At the end of the street, turn left.
note_fa: at the end (در پایانِ چیزی) با in the end (سرانجام) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A large area of land with a big house.
example_en: The family owns a large country estate.
examples_extra: The old estate covers hundreds of acres of land.
They live in a cottage on a large country estate.
note_fa: ملک بزرگ؛ housing estate یعنی شهرک مسکونی.

meaning_en: A test of your knowledge or ability.
example_en: I have an English exam tomorrow.
examples_extra: She has a maths exam on Friday morning.
He passed his driving exam on the second try.
note_fa: امتحان؛ pass/take an exam.

meaning_en: A reason you give to explain a mistake.
example_en: What's your excuse for being late?
examples_extra: He made up an excuse for being late.
That's no excuse for such rude behaviour.
note_fa: بهانه؛ make an excuse یعنی بهانه آوردن.

meaning_en: Physical activity to improve health, or to do it.
example_en: Regular exercise is good for you.
examples_extra: The soldiers exercise at dawn every day.
This grammar exercise helps you practise past tenses.
note_fa: هم اسم (تمرین) هم فعل (ورزش کردن).

meaning_en: The state of being real or present.
example_en: The existence of ghosts is debated.
examples_extra: The discovery proved the existence of ancient life.
She questioned the existence of true love.
note_fa: وجود، هستی؛ come into existence.

meaning_en: The physical or mental energy needed to do something.
example_en: It takes a lot of effort to learn a new language.
examples_extra: Learning a language takes a lot of effort.
She made a great effort to arrive on time.
note_fa: یعنی «تلاش»؛ make an effort هم‌آیند رایج است.

meaning_en: To make something into a particular shape or form.
example_en: She fashioned a hat from old newspapers.
examples_extra: The artist fashioned a bird from clay.
They fashioned tools from stone.
note_fa: این معنی فعل «شکل دادن» است، نه «مد».

meaning_en: a very large amount of money.
example_en: He made a fortune in business.
examples_extra: He made a fortune in real estate.
They spent a fortune on their wedding.
note_fa: ثروت هنگفت؛ a fortune یعنی یک عالمه پول.

meaning_en: to worry or make a lot of unnecessary trouble.
example_en: Don't fuss over small problems.
examples_extra: She made a big fuss about the small mistake.
Do not fuss over the children so much.
note_fa: make a fuss (about) یعنی سروصدا/هیاهو به پا کردن.

meaning_en: an activity with rules that people play.
example_en: Let's play a board game tonight.
examples_extra: The children are playing a board game.
Football is the most popular game in the world.
note_fa: game یعنی «بازی»؛ match یعنی «مسابقه» (بین دو تیم).

meaning_en: the activity of working in a garden.
example_en: My hobby is gardening.
examples_extra: Gardening is her favourite hobby.
He spends every weekend gardening.
note_fa: باغبانی؛ فعالیتی که با do نمی‌آید: go gardening.

meaning_en: to make a movement with your hand or head.
example_en: He gestured for me to come closer.
examples_extra: He made a friendly gesture with his hand.
She gestured for us to sit down.
note_fa: اسم و فعل؛ a kind gesture یعنی حرکت محبت‌آمیز.

meaning_en: to receive or obtain something.
example_en: I need to get some milk.
examples_extra: Did you get my message yesterday?
She gets a lot of emails every day.
note_fa: کتاب: get = got / got؛ پرکاربردترین فعل انگلیسی با معانی زیاد.

meaning_en: to find the correct answer to a question.
example_en: Did you get the answer to the math problem?
examples_extra: Did you get the answer to question five?
I always get the last answer wrong.
note_fa: get the answer یعنی «به جواب رسیدن».

meaning_en: to arrive at a place.
example_en: What time did you get home?
examples_extra: What time do you get home?
We got to the station late.
note_fa: get to + مکان یعنی رسیدن؛ get home بدون to می‌آید.

meaning_en: to become or start to be something.
example_en: It's getting dark outside.
examples_extra: It gets dark early in winter.
She got tired after the long walk.
note_fa: get + صفت یعنی «شدن»؛ غیررسمی‌تر از become.

meaning_en: to do or complete a task.
example_en: I need to get my homework done.
examples_extra: I must get my homework done tonight.
Did you get the shopping done?
note_fa: get sth done یعنی انجام دادن کار.

meaning_en: to go and bring something back.
example_en: Can you get me a glass of water?
examples_extra: Could you get my glasses from the kitchen?
I will get the children from school.

examples_extra: We set out at dawn.
They set out to change the world.
note_fa: یعنی شروع سفر یا کار.

meaning_en: to cause an alarm or explosion to start
example_en: The smoke set off the fire alarm.
examples_extra: The alarm was set off by mistake.
They set off the fireworks at midnight.
note_fa: یعنی به صدا درآوردن (آژیر) یا منفجر کردن.

meaning_en: to prepare equipment for use
example_en: Can you help me set up the new computer?
examples_extra: They set up the tents quickly.
He set up his own business.
note_fa: یعنی برپا کردن یا راه‌اندازی.

meaning_en: A device that sprays water for washing.
example_en: Our bathroom has a new shower.
examples_extra: I take a quick shower every single morning.
The hotel shower was far too hot today.
note_fa: دوش.

meaning_en: The ability to see.
example_en: His sight is getting worse with age.
examples_extra: He tragically lost his sight in the accident.
The beautiful sight amazed us all again today.
note_fa: بینایی؛ lose your sight.

meaning_en: A formal talk given to an audience.
example_en: The president gave a long speech.
examples_extra: The president gave a long speech yesterday.
She wrote her own wedding speech herself.
note_fa: سخنرانی؛ give/make a speech.

meaning_en: Give money to support an event or person.
example_en: A big company will sponsor the concert.
examples_extra: The company sponsors the local football team.
They sponsor a young child in Africa.
note_fa: حمایت مالی کردن؛ a sponsor.

meaning_en: A complete stop; no movement.
example_en: Traffic came to a standstill in the snow.
examples_extra: The factory came to a standstill during the strike.
The peace talks are at a complete standstill.
note_fa: توقف کامل؛ come to a standstill.

meaning_en: To no longer move or continue.
example_en: The car stopped suddenly.
examples_extra: The old bus stopped at every station.
It finally stopped raining an hour ago.
note_fa: متوقف شدن؛ stop = cease (رسمی).

meaning_en: Achieving a good result in work or business.
example_en: The new business was a great success.
examples_extra: Her success made the family proud.
The party was a great success.
note_fa: موفقیت.

meaning_en: An idea or plan that someone offers.
example_en: Do you have any suggestions for dinner?
examples_extra: Thanks for the useful suggestion.
May I make a suggestion?
note_fa: پیشنهاد.

meaning_en: To provide something that is needed.
example_en: The company supplies electricity to the city.
examples_extra: The company will supply parts worldwide.
They supply food to the school.
note_fa: تامین کردن.

meaning_en: To give help or encouragement to someone.
example_en: My family always supports my decisions.
examples_extra: Her friends support her decision.
Which team do you support?
note_fa: حمایت کردن.

meaning_en: To move through water using your body.
example_en: I like to swim in the ocean.
examples_extra: We swim in the sea every day.
She learnt to swim at five.
note_fa: شنا کردن.

meaning_en: To steal something.
example_en: Someone tried to take my bag.
examples_extra: Did someone take my bike?
Thieves take wallets and phones.
note_fa: «دزدیدن».

meaning_en: To wear a certain size of clothes.
example_en: What size shoes do you take?
examples_extra: I take size 12 in shoes.
What size do you take?
note_fa: «سایز پوشیدن»؛ take size 12.

meaning_en: To have classes to learn something.
example_en: I want to take guitar lessons.
examples_extra: She takes piano lessons weekly.
I want to take some driving lessons.
note_fa: «کلاس رفتن».

meaning_en: To accept something offered.
example_en: I'll take that offer, thank you.
examples_extra: Please take my good advice.
She will take the job.
note_fa: «قبول کردن».

meaning_en: To move something from a place.
example_en: Please take your feet off the table.
examples_extra: Take your shoes off here.
She will take her coat off.
note_fa: «برداشتن؛ بردن».

meaning_en: To steal something.
example_en: Someone took my wallet from my pocket.
examples_extra: Did someone take my wallet?
Don't take other people's things.
note_fa: «دزدیدن».

meaning_en: To write down information.
example_en: Can you take notes during the meeting?
examples_extra: Take notes during the lesson.
He will take my name and address.
note_fa: «یادداشت کردن»؛ take notes.

meaning_en: To stop working for a short time.
example_en: Let's take a break for coffee.
examples_extra: Let's take a ten-minute break.
Take a break every hour.
note_fa: «استراحت کردن».

meaning_en: To study a subject at school or college.
example_en: I want to take a cooking course.
examples_extra: She takes a cooking course.
I want to take an English course.
note_fa: «دوره گذراندن».

meaning_en: To look at something quickly.
example_en: Can you take a look at this report?
examples_extra: Take a look at this photo.
Can you take a look?
note_fa: «نگاهی انداختن».

meaning_en: To make a picture with a camera.
example_en: Let's take a photo together!
examples_extra: Can I take a photo here?
She takes a photo of us.
note_fa: «عکس گرفتن»؛ take a photo، نه make.

meaning_en: To do something dangerous or uncertain.
example_en: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
examples_extra: Don't take any unnecessary risks.
He takes a big risk.
note_fa: «ریسک کردن».

meaning_en: To travel by taxi.
example_en: We should take a taxi to the airport.
examples_extra: We take a taxi to the airport.
Let's take a taxi home.
note_fa: «تاکسی گرفتن».

meaning_en: To use an opportunity well.
example_en: Take advantage of the good weather.
examples_extra: Take advantage of this offer.
She takes advantage of every opportunity.
note_fa: «از فرصت استفاده کردن».

meaning_en: To do a test at school.
example_en: I need to take an exam tomorrow.
examples_extra: I have to take an exam tomorrow.
She takes her driving exam soon.
note_fa: «امتحان دادن»؛ take/do an exam.

meaning_en: To look or behave like a parent.
example_en: She takes after her mother.
examples_extra: She takes after her mother.
He takes after his father.
note_fa: «به کسی رفتن»؛ شبیه بودن.

meaning_en: To return something you bought.
example_en: I need to take these shoes back.
examples_extra: I take back what I said.
She takes the dress back tomorrow.
note_fa: «پس گرفتن»؛ حرف را پس گرفتن.

meaning_en: To start managing a situation.
example_en: The new manager will take control.
examples_extra: She takes control of the situation.
He takes control of things quickly.
note_fa: «کنترل را به دست گرفتن».

meaning_en: To make clothes smaller.
example_en: This dress is too big; I need to take it in.
examples_extra: She takes in her dress.
The tailor takes in my trousers.
note_fa: «تنگ کردن لباس».

meaning_en: To employ someone.
example_en: We plan to take on new staff.
examples_extra: We must take on more staff.
The company takes on new workers.
note_fa: «استخدام کردن».

meaning_en: To get control of something.
example_en: The new company will take over next month.
examples_extra: Nelson will take over as manager.
She takes over the family business.
note_fa: «به عهده گرفتن».

meaning_en: To remove clothes.
example_en: Please take off your shoes.
examples_extra: She takes off her shoes.
Please take off your coat.
note_fa: «درآوردن لباس».

meaning_en: To happen, to occur.
example_en: The concert will take place next week.
examples_extra: The meeting takes place today.
The wedding will take place in June.
note_fa: «برگزار شدن»؛ رخ دادن.

meaning_en: To bring someone to a place.
example_en: I can take you to the station.
examples_extra: He takes me to the airport.
She takes the children to school.
note_fa: «کسی را به جایی بردن».

meaning_en: To travel by bus.
example_en: I take the bus to school.
examples_extra: I take the bus to work.
He takes the bus every day.
note_fa: «با اتوبوس رفتن».

meaning_en: To travel by train.
example_en: We will take the train to London.
examples_extra: He takes the train to London.
We take the train daily.
note_fa: «با قطار رفتن».

meaning_en: To travel by subway or metro.
example_en: I take the underground to work.
examples_extra: In London you can take the underground.
She takes the underground to work.
note_fa: «با مترو رفتن».

meaning_en: To relax and not worry.
example_en: After work, I like to take it easy.
examples_extra: Take things easy this weekend.
She takes it easy today.
note_fa: «استراحت کردن»؛ آرام گرفتن.

meaning_en: To make clothes shorter.
example_en: This skirt is too long; I need to take it up.
examples_extra: She takes up her skirt.
The tailor takes up the trousers.
note_fa: «کوتاه کردن لباس».

meaning_en: Do physical activity to stay healthy.
example_en: I take exercise every morning.
examples_extra: You should take more exercise.
He takes exercise every morning.
note_fa: «ورزش کردن».

meaning_en: Wash your body with water.
example_en: I take a shower before bed.
examples_extra: I take a shower every morning.
You can take/have a shower now.
note_fa: «دوش گرفتن».

meaning_en: Choose what to do after thinking.
example_en: We need to make a decision soon.
examples_extra: You should take/make a decision soon.
We take/make important decisions every day.
note_fa: «تصمیم گرفتن».

meaning_en: Aim at something or someone.
example_en: The campaign targets young voters.
examples_extra: The ad targets young people.
We target new customers daily.
note_fa: «هدف قرار دادن».

meaning_en: A car that takes you places for money.
example_en: Let's take a taxi to the airport.
examples_extra: Hurry up! The taxi's here.
Let's take a taxi home.
note_fa: «تاکسی».

meaning_en: A hot drink made from tea leaves.
example_en: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples_extra: I prefer coffee to tea.
She drinks green tea daily.
note_fa: «چای».

meaning_en: A person who rents a house or apartment.
example_en: The tenant pays rent every month.
examples_extra: The new tenant pays monthly.
Are you a tenant here?
note_fa: «مستأجر».

meaning_en: To reduce the volume or strength of something.
example_en: Please turn down the music.
examples_extra: Please turn the music down.
She turned down the heating.
note_fa: کم کردن (صدا/حرارت)؛ turn it down.

meaning_en: To happen in a particular way, or be discovered.
example_en: The party turned out to be a great success.
examples_extra: The party turned out great.
It turned out to be a mistake.
note_fa: نتیجه دادن/از آب درآمدن؛ turn out well.

meaning_en: To arrive or appear unexpectedly.
meaning_fa: سر و کله پیدا شدن، ظاهر شدن
example_en: He didn't turn up for the meeting.
examples_extra: He turned up late for dinner.
She turned up completely unexpectedly.
note_fa: سر رسیدن/ظاهر شدن (غیرمنتظره).

meaning_en: what you can see from a place
example_en: Our hotel room has a beautiful view.
examples_extra: The view from the window is lovely.
In my honest view, we should wait longer.
note_fa: منظره و دیدگاه؛ in my view.

meaning_en: Fighting between countries or groups, often with weapons.
example_en: Many people suffer during a war.
examples_extra: The brutal civil war lasted five long years.
Cruel war always brings great suffering to all.
note_fa: جنگ.
